shortDescription: Framework for entad items: randomly rolled traits by rarity that modify stats, damage, abilities and buildings, stay hidden until revealed, and make every entad more durable by its highest rarity.
body:
## Durability
- Every item with at least one entad trait gets its MaxHitPoints multiplied by `EntadSettings.Durability[highest trait rarity]`. Defaults: Common x1.25, Uncommon x1.5, Rare x2, Epic x3, Legendary x5. Each is adjustable from 1 to 10 in the settings (General tab), and "Reset to defaults" covers them. The multiplier is applied last in `StatPart_Entad.TransformValue` and is never hidden.
- HP keeps its health fraction on trait add/remove (`RescaleHitPoints`), when the settings window closes mid-game (`EntadMod.WriteSettings` → `EntadUtility.RescaleDurability`, every map and caravan), and on load (`SyncDurability`, against the saved `scaledDurability`, default 1 for old saves). A full-health item snaps to the new maximum.
- MaxHitPoints is always injected but stays immutable; every real change calls `ClearCacheForThing`.

## Furniture mood (EntadMoods.cs)
- Prefix on `Pawn_JobTracker.CleanupCurrentJob`. Counts as "used":
  - The job's building (targetA) for a bill, Research or any job with a joyKind (this includes modded recreation, e.g. Dubs Bad Hygiene's takeBath), once the job Succeeded or the pawn is on the building's interaction cell.
  - A sittable building under the pawn when seated: on the used building's interaction cell, at the end of a completed joy job at a building without one (TV), or after a meal that Succeeded.
  - The bed from `pawn.CurrentBed()` for LayDown / LayDownAwake / LayDownResting.
  - The eating surface after a Succeeded Ingest.
- Not counted: jobs with no bill/research/joyKind (e.g. DBH toilets, showers, sinks), walking across, cleaning, hauling, walks, skygazing.
- Stacking: `Thought_EntadFurniture` records the building's `thingIDNumber` (saved as `entadSourceId`). The same building renews its own memory; different buildings and equipped items stack up to the thought's stackLimit (Contentment: 3, default stackedEffectMultiplier 0.75 → +4/+7/+9.25). At the cap a new building replaces the oldest furniture memory; equipped-item memories are never displaced.

## Random mood traits (Fickle Cheer)
- `EntadTraitDef.MoodCandidates`: every loaded ThoughtDef (vanilla, DLC and other mods, built on first use) that is a plain memory (`ThoughtClass == Thought_Memory`), single visible stage, no required traits/genes, no nextThought/thoughtToMake, label and description without `{`/`[` placeholders, not nullified by Psychopath (death/atrocity memories), and mood within the trait's thoughtMoodRange.

## Wearer stats (EntadWearerStats.cs)
- Entad trait offsets on pawn stats reach the holder through a postfix on `StatWorker.StatOffsetFromGear`. `StatPart_Entad` skips those offsets on apparel/equipment so they aren't counted twice.
- Offsets display in the stat's unfinalized style (`Worker.ValueToString(v, false, Offset)`): ShootingAccuracyPawn offsets are skill levels (Steady Hands 1–4).
- "Relevant gear" lists only items with a non-zero revealed offset.

## Hiding unrevealed traits in displays
Gameplay always applies every trait. Thread-static flags make displays leave hidden ones out: `displayExcludesHidden` (gear line), `gearCardThing` (equipped-offset rows), `infoCardThing` (item info card, every stat except MaxHitPoints). Hidden traits count toward market value as the flat "unidentified" bonus.

## Startup
- `EntadCompInjector` adds `CompProperties_Entad` to every compatible ThingWithComps def and builds `MayHaveComp` (per-def-index table).
- `EntadStatPartInjector` adds `StatPart_Entad` to every stat a trait references plus MarketValue and MaxHitPoints, then applies each `[HarmonyPatch]` class in its own try/catch.
- `EntadAbilityPrep` copies abilities per trait; copies get their own defName hash and short hash. Reflection targets are null-safe.

## Save compatibility
- `Patch_BackCompatibleDefName` maps removed duplicate traits to their replacements: RapidCycling/Stormfeed → HairTrigger, AcceleratedRounds → HeavySlugs, BrutalEdge → HeavyHitter, Parrying → Evasion, MarksmansEye → SteadyHands, BlessedComfort → SoothingPresence.
- `AppliedEntadTrait.ExposeData` reads the saved def name as a string while loading; if it differs from the resolved def, the values are re-rolled at the saved rarity.

## Building properties
- Fuel/glow/power/heat factors from `CompEntad.PropertyFactor`, reveal checks via `hiddenPropertyMask`. Glow re-registers (`ForceRegister`) only on trait add/remove, never on reveal.

## Weapons
- Extra damage: `Projectile.Impact` postfix (non-bullets) and `Bullet.Impact` postfix.
- Searing: Burn 1–4 (Uncommon, scales). Cinderstrike: Flame 4–10, Epic, can ignite. Frostbite: extra Frostbite 2–6 (Rare).

## Reveal triggers (EntadStatReveal.cs)
- Every trigger first checks `HasHiddenGear`. Learn: trickle XP (< 1) only on the pawn's 250-tick hash tick; one-off grants always.

## Meals
- `[ThreadStatic] eating` flag around `Thing.Ingested` so the ThoughtsFromIngesting postfix only runs for real meals.

## API (EntadApi.cs)
- Request objects are never modified. Removed (unused anywhere): `discoveryMessage`, `BaseMarketValue`, range `Normalize`; `Roll()` private.

## Content
- Trait labels are Title Case in the XML.
- Restful (furniture): Restful Sigh ability, non-hostile, 250-tick cast, gives `Entad_RestfulCalm` (pain x0.5, 4 h), once a day.
- Steady Surgeon uses MedicalSurgerySuccessChance.

## Build setup
- net472, Krafs.Rimworld.Ref 1.6.4871 pinned, Lib.Harmony 2.4.1 compile-only; no publicizer. modVersion 1.0.0.

## Open items
- Def hot-reload doesn't re-run the injectors.
- Possible: count any needs-satisfying use of a building (toilets, showers) as furniture use. Proposed to the user, not built.
- Pending: translation keys (Languages/English/Keyed), Forge Frenzy-style settings tabs.

## Dev tools
- "Add specific Entad trait" lists applicable traits first, then the rest, alphabetically.
